description: Try a letter out. Defaults to a PREVIEW: the letter is built exactly as it would be posted and you get a PDF link back — no eBrief.de job, no postage. Pass really_send: true to actually post it (use your own address; it costs postage and is the only way to check the envelope window and folding). Address it either with lead_id or with an explicit `to`. Content is either body (plain text, drawn server-side) or document_id (a stored PDF, posted as it is). Test letters are marked as such in the letter history.

document_id.description: A stored PDF to post as the letter, instead of body.

lead_id.description: Use this lead's postal address. Omit if you pass `to`.

really_send.description: Actually post it. Default false = preview only.

to.description: An explicit address, so no throwaway lead has to be created for a test.

name: send_test_letter
